answer: The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, capped per identity per epoch, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. What survives to the sonnet is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Each submission hangs on the lagoon of a task receipt, and the ivory is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
